scenes.say: Thursday Island sits in the Torres Strait, just off the tip of Cape York.
scenes.show: Thursday Island sits in the Torres Strait, just off the tip of Cape York.

stat.label: Off the tip of Cape York, QLD

scenes.say: From the late eighteen-hundreds, it boomed as a pearling port.
scenes.show: From the late 1800s, it boomed as a pearling port.

scenes.say: Its boats employed more than two thousand men. About a third of the divers were Japanese.
scenes.show: Its boats employed more than 2,000 men. About a third of the divers were Japanese.

scenes.say: Its name, Waiben, is often said to mean no water. The island had no permanent supply.
scenes.show: Its name, Waiben, is often said to mean 'no water'. The island had no permanent supply.

scenes.say: In eighteen-ninety, the Quetta sank in the Torres Strait. A church here still honours those lost.
scenes.show: In 1890, the Quetta sank in the Torres Strait. A church here still honours those lost.

scenes.say: Today, this little island is often called the capital of the Torres Strait.
scenes.show: Today, this little island is often called the capital of the Torres Strait.
